verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim 'Turn a Figma frame into a working app' and also support starting from an existing website/design ('Begin from a website you already own', 'Share a public website link... to instantly copy the design'), directly matching the story's core ask. However, there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of Figma import fidelity, and details on file format support, layer/component mapping, or limitations are absent. Missing for 10: independent verification of Figma import quality, technical detail on fidelity/limitations, community hands-on reports of this specific feature.
